_doc: Candidate visual styles for the code-rendered whiteboard track. Every style renders the SAME sample scene (scripts/render_styles.py) so they compare by eye. Tokens: bg, floor (lower band color or null), ink, inkWidth, roughness/bowing (rough.js), fillStyle (solid|hachure|zigzag|cross-hatch|none), palette (blue gold red green brown), fontH/fontL (Google Fonts families), caps (uppercase headings), glow (neon stroke glow), paper (noise overlay), grid (dot grid), mode (rough|flat|mograph). Mike (2026-10-30): keep EVERY candidate as an option (a multi-chapter video may want dark mode in one chapter, light in another); status 'current' marks today's pick, status_note keeps his remarks.

styles.name: Paper & pastel
styles.blurb: Closest to the Shapiro reference: white paper, black ink, flat pastel fills, two hand fonts. Included as the baseline to move AWAY from. Label font is Kalam (Shadows Into Light is not in @remotion/google-fonts, so the render and the picker use the same face).
styles.status_note: Mike, 2026-10-30: the pick for the first demo ('paper and pencil')

styles.name: Paper & Quant orange
styles.blurb: Paper & pastel re-inked for the quant video (Mike, 2026-11-04): white paper, quant.network's warm near-black ink (#43403E), and ORANGE as the one accent (the site's #F15A22, a pastel tint of it for fills) instead of the pastel rainbow. The role palette keeps its names: gold = money (pale orange), red = the highlighted / hot thing (solid orange), blue = machines (warm light grey), green = good (the site's green, tinted), brown = people / the animal, grey = ghosted. Headings in the site's orange (#F15A22), like every quant.network headline (Mike, 2026-11-04 after the first sample). Same fonts and wobble as paper-pastel.
styles.status_note: Mike, 2026-11-04: the quant video's pen (paper and pastel + the site's orange). Every other pen stays an option.

styles.name: Navy chalk
styles.blurb: House palette on a near-black navy board: pale chalk ink, teal + gold hachure fills, rougher stroke. Continuity with the Pixar b-roll backgrounds.

styles.name: Blackboard marker
styles.blurb: Caleb-adjacent: pure black, thin white marker, no fills, a fixed 7-marker palette used semantically (yellow titles, magenta flow, green good, red bad, periwinkle terms).

styles.name: Kraft & ink
styles.blurb: Warm kraft paper, dark-brown ink, zigzag marker fills in muted blue/mustard/brick/olive. Reads 'field notebook', not 'SaaS explainer'.

styles.name: Blueprint
styles.blurb: Engineering blueprint: deep blue ground with a dot grid, white-blue ink, cross-hatch fills, cyan + amber accents. Technical and distinctly un-cartoon.

styles.name: Flat clean
styles.blurb: No wobble at all: rounded flat-vector shapes, bold saturated fills, no outlines, rounded sans type. Kurzgesagt-lite. One package fewer (no rough.js).

styles.name: Neon ink
styles.blurb: Near-black with thin glowing hand strokes and neon accents (cyan, yellow, pink, green). The bridge between a whiteboard and the FireHustle mograph look.

styles.name: Marker white
styles.blurb: Thick black marker on white with heavy wobble and saturated primary fills. The hand-inked doodle look (SimpleProfessor's style), but vector and consistent.

styles.name: Mograph black
styles.blurb: The FireHustle direction: black, glossy rounded tiles with outer glow, a ring chart, coin discs, bold caps labels with glow. No hand-drawn strokes anywhere.

styles.name: Ink & muted wash
styles.blurb: Round 2. Warm paper, dark-navy ink with only a light wobble, muted solid fills, a serif heading. Illustrated and warm, but grown-up; the wobble is a whisper, not the signature.

styles.name: Editorial charcoal
styles.blurb: Round 2. White page, charcoal ink almost without wobble, restrained two-tone fills, a Playfair heading with a plain sans for labels. Reads like a newspaper explainer graphic.

styles.name: Slate board
styles.blurb: Round 2. Dark slate (not black, not navy), off-white ink, SOLID muted-bright fills instead of chalk hatching, rounded sans heading. The dark-room seriousness without the chalkboard cliche.

styles.name: Newsprint, one accent
styles.blurb: Round 2. Cream newsprint, black ink, everything in warm greys except ONE accent (gold) plus red for warnings. Calm, editorial, instantly directs the eye to the thing that matters.
